title: 9 Best Workflow Automation Tools & Software for 2026

facts.fact: Atlassian's page lists Jira's paid plans as starting at $8.15 per user per month.
facts.quote: Jira | Marketing, Operations, IT, Design, Product, Software, and cross-functional teams for small to enterprise organizations | Yes (up to 10 users) | $8.15/user/mo

facts.fact: Atlassian's page states that Jira's free plan supports up to 10 users.
Atlassian's page lists Zapier's free plan as including 100 tasks per month.
Atlassian's page lists Zapier's paid plans as starting at $19.99 per month.
Atlassian's page lists Make's free plan as including 1,000 operations per month.
Atlassian's page lists Make's paid plans as starting at $9 per month.
Atlassian's page states that n8n's free option is self-hosted.
Atlassian's page lists n8n's cloud plan as starting at $20 per month.
Atlassian's page lists Monday.com's free plan as covering 2 users.
Atlassian's page lists Monday.com's paid plans as starting at $9 per user per month.
Atlassian's page lists Asana's free plan as covering up to 10 users.
Atlassian's page lists Asana's paid plans as starting at $10.99 per user per month.
Atlassian's page lists ClickUp's paid plans as starting at $7 per user per month.
Atlassian's page lists HubSpot's paid plans as starting at $15 per user per month.
Atlassian's page states that Smartsheet does not offer a free plan.
Atlassian's page lists Smartsheet's paid plans as starting at $9 per user per month.
Atlassian states that the pricing in its comparison table is as of 2026 and that readers should verify current pricing on vendor websites.
facts.quote: Pricing as of 2026. Always verify current pricing on vendor websites.

facts.fact: Atlassian states that its list of nine tools was evaluated on automation depth, ease of use, AI capabilities, and fit for teams of different sizes and technical comfort levels.
facts.quote: evaluated on automation depth, ease of use, AI capabilities, and how well it fits teams of different sizes and technical comfort levels
